decks.name: First Hellos
decks.blurb: The questions every great love story starts with.
cards: What's the story behind your name? Does it mean anything special?
What does a perfect lazy Sunday look like for you?
What's the first thing you do when you wake up in the morning?
Are you a coffee person, a tea person, or a 'don't talk to me until noon' person?
What's your go-to comfort food when the day has been rough?
What city or place feels like home to you, even if you've never lived there?
What's something you're weirdly good at?
What's the last song you had on repeat?
Morning person or night owl — and has anyone ever convinced you to switch?
What's a small thing that instantly makes your day better?
If you could have dinner with any one person, living or not, who would it be?
What's your favorite way to spend a rainy day?
What was your dream job as a kid?
What's a skill you've always wanted to learn but never got around to?
What's the most beautiful place you've ever been?
Do you believe in love at first sight, or is that just movie magic?
What's your love language — words, touch, time, gifts, or acts of service?
What's something on your bucket list that surprises people?
What's the best compliment you've ever received?
If we met in person for the first time tomorrow, what's the first thing you'd want to show me?

decks.name: Fun & Funny
cards: If you were a vegetable, which one would you be and why?
What's the weirdest dream you've ever had that you still remember?
If we had a theme song as a couple, what would it be?
What's the most embarrassing song on your playlist?
If you could swap lives with me for one day, what's the first thing you'd do?
What's the funniest thing you've ever Googled?
If our relationship had a mascot, what animal would it be?
What's your most useless talent?
If you had to eat only one cuisine for the rest of your life, which survives?
What's the silliest argument you've ever had with someone?
If we were on a reality show together, which one would we win?
What's a conspiracy theory you low-key believe?
If you could add one ridiculous law everyone had to follow, what would it be?
What's the worst haircut you've ever had? Describe it in detail.
If your life had a blooper reel, what's on it?
What's something you believed as a kid that turned out to be completely wrong?
If we were cartoon characters, who would we be?
Dance battle: what song do you bring, and what's your signature move?
What's the most dramatic overreaction you've ever had to something tiny?
If you had to narrate my life like a sports commentator right now, what would you say?

decks.name: Sweet Nothings
cards: What's the sweetest thing anyone has ever done for you?
When did you first realize you were falling for me?
What's your favorite memory of us so far?
What do you miss most about me when we're apart?
What's a little thing I do that makes you smile every time?
If you could bottle one moment with me and keep it forever, which would you pick?
What's the most romantic movie moment you wish we could live out?
What nickname would you give me if you had to invent one right now?
What's something about me that you find beautiful that I probably don't even notice?
If you could write me a three-word love note, what would it say?
What's the first thing you want to do when we finally meet in person?
What's a song that reminds you of me?
What's the kindest thing I could do for you today?
If our love had a flavor, what would it taste like?
What's your favorite thing about the way we talk to each other?
What do you daydream about when you think of us?
What's one promise you want to make to me right now?
If you could give me one gift that money can't buy, what would it be?
What makes you feel most loved by me?
Describe our perfect evening together in three sentences.

decks.name: Flirty
decks.blurb: A little mischief, a lot of chemistry.
cards: What's the most attractive thing about me that has nothing to do with looks?
If we were stuck in an elevator together for an hour, what would happen?
What's your favorite physical feature of mine? Be specific.
What's the boldest thing you've ever wanted to say to me but didn't?
If you could kiss me right now, where would we be?
What's something I do that you find unexpectedly attractive?
Describe your ideal slow dance with me — song, setting, everything.
What's the flirtiest text you've ever sent? Show me.
If we had one night with zero rules, where would we go?
What's a secret little fantasy you've never told anyone?
What would you do if I showed up at your door right now?
What's the most romantic place you've ever imagined us together?
If you could steal one kiss from any moment in our story so far, which would you pick?
What's something you want to whisper in my ear?
How would you describe the way I make you feel in one word? Now explain it.
What's your idea of the perfect goodnight?
If our first kiss were a movie scene, how would it play out?
What's one thing you're dying to do together that we haven't yet?

decks.name: Memories
cards: What's your very first memory of me?
What was going through your head the first time we talked?
What's the funniest memory we share?
What's a moment with me that you replay in your head when you can't sleep?
What was the first thing about me that surprised you?
What's the sweetest message I've ever sent you?
What's a 'remember when' story you love telling about us?
What's the hardest we've ever laughed together?
What's a small moment between us that felt huge at the time?
What's the first photo or video of mine that made your heart skip?
What's something we used to do together that you miss?
What's the most meaningful gift I've ever given you — and why did it matter?
What's a tradition we've started without even realizing it?
What's the bravest thing we've done together?
What's a moment you wish you could relive with me?
What's something I said early on that stuck with you?
Tell our story in one paragraph — your version.
If we made a scrapbook of us, what goes on the first page?

decks.name: Would You Rather
decks.blurb: Choose wisely. There are no wrong answers. (Mostly.)
cards: Would you rather have a video call every night or one surprise visit a month?
Would you rather we lived in a tiny cabin in the mountains or a beach house?
Would you rather know everything I'm thinking or keep some mystery?
Would you rather have unlimited date nights or unlimited travel together?
Would you rather I serenade you badly or cook you a terrible dinner?
Would you rather wake up to a love letter or fall asleep to my voice?
Would you rather we met in a rom-com or an adventure movie?
Would you rather have a star named after us or a song written about us?
Would you rather slow dance in the kitchen or stargaze on a rooftop?
Would you rather I plan a surprise date or we plan it together?
Would you rather we never argued again, or argued but always made up beautifully?
Would you rather have a time machine to relive our best day or a crystal ball to see our future?
Would you rather be snowed in together for a week or road-tripping with no destination?
Would you rather I remembered every anniversary or surprised you on random Tuesdays?
Would you rather hold hands everywhere or have a secret signal only we know?
Would you rather our first dance be slow and sweet or fun and silly?
Would you rather read each other's diaries or keep some pages private forever?
Would you rather have one grand romantic gesture a year or tiny sweet ones every day?
Would you rather fall asleep on a call together or wake up to a good morning voice note?
Would you rather we aged like fine wine or stayed young at heart forever?

decks.name: Long-Distance Survival
cards: What's the hardest part of the distance for you, honestly?
What gets you through the lonely nights?
What are we counting down to right now — and how are you feeling about it?
What's one thing we should do together this week despite the distance?
How do you want me to comfort you when you're having a bad day far away?
What's a new ritual we could start to feel closer?
What's the first thing you'll do when we close the distance?
What's something you wish I understood better about your daily life?
How do we keep the spark alive when we can't touch?
What's the longest we've gone without talking, and how did it feel?
What's a surprise I could plan that would make the distance feel smaller?
What do you tell people when they ask how we make long distance work?
What's one thing the distance has actually made better about us?
If you could teleport to me for just one hour, what would we do?
What's your favorite way we've ever spent time together online?
What's something you're looking forward to doing in person that we can't do on a call?
How do you want to celebrate when we finally meet?
What promise do we make to each other about the distance?

decks.name: Gratitude
decks.blurb: Say thank you like you mean it.
cards: What's something I did recently that you're grateful for?
What's a quality of mine you're thankful I have?
Who in your life are you most grateful for, and why?
What's a small everyday thing you never want to take for granted?
What's something about our relationship you're grateful for today?
What's the kindest thing a stranger has ever done for you?
What's a hard time in your life that you're now grateful for?
What about your body or health are you thankful for right now?
What's a simple pleasure that never fails to make you grateful?
What's something I believed about you that you're grateful for?
What's a memory you're grateful we got to make together?
What about your family are you thankful for?
What's a lesson someone taught you that you're grateful for?
What's something about where you live right now that you appreciate?
What's a dream you have that you're grateful you get to chase?
Write me a tiny thank-you note for something only I'd understand.

decks.name: Reassurance
decks.blurb: For the days you need to hear it.
cards: What's worrying you right now? Let me carry some of it.
What do you need to hear from me today?
What's a fear you have about us that you've been holding in?
What makes you feel most secure in our relationship?
When you feel distant from me, what helps you feel close again?
What's something you're afraid to ask me?
What do I do that makes you feel safe?
What's a doubt you've had that turned out to be wrong?
How can I love you better when you're feeling insecure?
What's something you need me to promise you?
What does 'forever' mean to you when you say it about us?
What's the strongest evidence you have that we're going to make it?
When you're overthinking at 2am, what would you want me to say?
What's something about us that will never change, no matter what?
If you could hear one sentence from me on repeat, what would it be?
What do you want me to remember about you on your hardest days?

decks.name: Date Night
decks.blurb: Plan it, dream it, do it.
cards: Describe your dream date night with me, start to finish.
What's a date we've never done that you really want to try?
Fancy restaurant or street food adventure — what's our vibe tonight?
What's the perfect movie for our next watch-together?
If we cooked together tonight, what would we make?
What's a virtual date idea we haven't tried yet?
What's your ideal ratio of planning vs. spontaneity on a date?
What's the most romantic meal you've ever had?
If we had an unlimited date-night budget, what would we do?
What's a little surprise you'd love on a date night?
What's your favorite thing to wear on a date with me?
What's the best first-date story you've ever heard — besides ours?
If we could have a date anywhere in the world tonight, where?
What's a date-night tradition you want us to start?
What's the perfect end to a perfect date night?
What's something silly we should do on our next date just for fun?
How do you like to be asked out — grand gesture or casual 'hey, you free?'
What's a date idea that would surprise me?

decks.name: Ooh, You're Asking That!
cards: What's the most trouble you've ever been in? Full story.
What's a secret you've never told anyone — until now?
What's the biggest risk you've ever taken for love?
What's something you pretend to like but secretly don't?
What's the most embarrassing thing in your search history right now?
What's a hot take you have that most people would disagree with?
What's the pettiest thing you've ever done?
What's something you've kept to yourself that you should probably confess?
What's your most controversial food opinion?
What's the weirdest compliment you've ever received?
What's something you're weirdly competitive about?
What's the last thing that made you cry?
What's a grudge you've held way too long?
What's something you do when no one's watching?
What's the most rebellious thing you've ever done?
If you could ask me anything and I'd have to answer honestly, what would it be?

decks.name: Dream Together
decks.blurb: Let's build the future out loud.
cards: Where do you see us in five years? Paint the picture.
What's our dream home like? Describe every room.
What city do we end up in — or do we keep wandering?
What's a dream trip we absolutely have to take together?
What does our perfect ordinary Tuesday look like someday?
What's a tradition you want us to have when we're old?
What do you want our life to feel like, in one word?
What's something you want us to learn together?
What's a big dream of yours that I can help with?
What's our retirement plan — beach, mountains, or something wilder?
What would you name our future pet, and what kind is it?
What's a skill you want us to be 'that couple' known for?
What's the first thing we do the morning after we move in together?
What's a dream you're scared to say out loud? Say it here.
What kind of parents do you think we'd be?
What's a project we could build together?
What's the legacy you want us to leave?
If we wrote our story's next chapter tonight, what happens?

decks.name: How Well Do You Know Me?
decks.blurb: Guess first — then I'll tell you the truth.
cards: What's my go-to order at a restaurant?
What's my biggest pet peeve?
What's the movie I can quote from start to finish?
What's my most-used emoji?
What would I grab first if my place was on fire — after people and pets?
What's my guilty pleasure TV show?
What's the food I can't stand?
What's my favorite season, and why?
What's something I'm secretly really proud of?
What's my usual coffee or tea order?
What's the app I spend the most time on?
What's my biggest fear?
What's my love language — and am I right about yours?
What's the gift I'd love most that no one would guess?
What's my idea of a perfect birthday?
What's something I always forget to do?
What's my hidden talent?
What's the compliment that would mean the most to me right now?

decks.name: Deep Waters
decks.blurb: For when you're ready to go deeper.
cards: What's a wound from your past that's still healing?
What's something you've never forgiven yourself for?
What does love mean to you now versus five years ago?
What's the hardest goodbye you've ever said?
What's something you believed about yourself that you're unlearning?
What are you most afraid of losing?
What's a part of you that you hide from most people?
What's the loneliest you've ever felt?
What would you tell your younger self about love?
What's something you need but struggle to ask for?
What's a belief you hold that you've never said out loud?
What's the difference between being alone and being lonely, for you?
What's something about grief or loss that changed you?
What do you want to be remembered for?
What's the most vulnerable you've ever felt with me?
If you could be fully, completely known by one person, what would you want them to see first?
